findings.claim: The T7 line says 'the third in L104 and L105', but L105 answers the fourth review (1624a674..c6c7c518), not the third. The line never names the fourth review, so the review-to-entry map is wrong, and L105 itself claims the line 'names the third review in L104 and L105'. A reader following the line gets the wrong entry for the fourth review.

The follow-up line says it was 'raised by `c6c7c518`, L104'. L104 answers the third review, which covers 1f02cd0a..1624a674 and does not include c6c7c518. The attribution is muddled: c6c7c518 is the commit that was reviewed in the fourth review, and the follow-up line itself first appeared in the L104 commit. The reference should be L105, which answers the fourth review.

evidence: The only changed path is the odd/tasks feature document, and the whole diff was read.
L105 counts 4 findings (F1, F1 (2nd), F2, F2 (2nd)), which matches the finding ids it answers.
The T7 checkbox is fixed from the malformed '-- [x]' to '- [x]'.
The T9 line now points at the open T7 follow-up line, as L105 says.
